authoritative_image_population.definition: the 256 unique Image_filename values in the clinical sheet
authoritative_image_population.reason: each source row explicitly names one ultrasound B-mode image and all 256 names resolve uniquely

ordering.array_items: source cell order; Mask_other_filename is split on literal '&' without reordering

identifiers_and_paths.image_path: POSIX-style path formed as <png_directory>/<Image_filename>, relative to source_image_root
identifiers_and_paths.case_id: decimal string form of CaseID, required because the canonical schema requires a string or null

join_and_grouping.clinical_to_image: exact, case-sensitive basename equality; measured one-to-one (256/256)
join_and_grouping.clinical_to_tumor_mask: exact, case-sensitive basename equality for non-null values; measured one-to-one (252/252)
join_and_grouping.clinical_to_other_masks: split non-null source cells on literal '&', then exact basename equality; 14/14 match
join_and_grouping.output_grouping: one output record per clinical row/image; mask paths from that same row remain grouped in that record

modality.provenance: Data Dictionary description for Image_filename: 'ultrasound b-mode image(s)'

anatomy.provenance: workbook/dataset title and Data Dictionary description of Tissue_composition as breast tissue composition

annotation_fields.tumor_mask_paths: zero-or-one string array from Mask_tumor_filename, prefixed with png_directory
annotation_fields.other_mask_paths: string array from Mask_other_filename split on literal '&', prefixed with png_directory
annotation_fields.age: Age, preserving source integer or string
annotation_fields.birads: BIRADS, preserving source integer or string

excluded_fields.reason: represented by top-level image_id and image_path
losslessly normalized into ordered individual string paths in other_mask_paths

unresolved_decisions.question: May the converter decode supplied mask PNGs to derive tight axis-aligned bounding boxes around nonzero pixels?
unresolved_decisions.proposed_resolution: No. Preserve mask paths only and do not create bounding boxes unless the user explicitly permits mask decoding.
